question: Did Stage A fail because the outer-repository response projection lacks transferable response signal, or because ROC AUC inside a five-Task future block leaves too few valid observations for repository-level precision?

fixed_method.representation: Reuse the exact observed RCP fitted for every H5 target Origin; do not refit or change any direction.
fixed_method.evaluation_rows: For each target Origin and active configuration with both terminal classes in the complete eligible target history, compute ROC AUC of z[t,a] for y[t,a].
fixed_method.aggregation: Average valid configurations within Origin, Origins within repository, then repositories equally.
fixed_method.uncertainty: Ten thousand repository bootstrap resamples with seed 20260728.
fixed_method.negative_control: Repeat the complete fitting and history-AUC audit for the same nineteen deterministic within-fitting-repository outcome permutations already frozen for Stage A.
fixed_method.null_rate: Use the corrected upper-tail rate (one plus null values at least as high as observed) divided by twenty.
fixed_method.information_boundary: Target outcomes are read only to score the already fitted representation. They never enter fitting, forecast, or Selection.

transferable_signal_supported_if: repository-macro history AUC is greater than 0.5
repository bootstrap 95 percent lower bound is greater than 0.5
at least 9 of 13 repositories have mean history AUC greater than 0.5
every leave-one-repository-out macro history AUC is greater than 0.5
the corrected permutation as-good-or-better rate is below 0.10
interpretation.if_supported: Record that RCP has static response relevance but ALG-013 remains rejected and Stage B remains unopened. A later candidate must independently specify a better-powered pre-Origin future-increment test before any Selection.
interpretation.if_rejected: Close the RCP representation family on the current source and proceed to the distinct response-composition partial-pooling family or stop current-source algorithm research.
forbidden: running ALG-013 Stage B or Stage C
altering the projection, embedding, horizon, repository weights, or threshold
